scope: Nine historical annual Commander preconstructed product families: Commander (2011) and Commander 2013–2020. Each code covers a release family, potentially with multiple independently packaged decks; it is not a single deck or premier booster set.
source_policy: Direct first-party Wizards Japanese product detail pages establish exact annual Commander family names and that the releases include preconstructed Commander decks. Scryfall supplies the code and first-print date independently. No deck counts, card legality or new-design totals are inferred from source-page labels.
